verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own docs point to a software stack for this hardware: a CUDA tuning guide for Blackwell GPUs, the NeMo framework for training and fine-tuning LLMs, and DGX B300 marketed with 'full-stack software' for training and inference. None of these explicitly names PyTorch or other mainstream frameworks, or provides B300 support matrices. missing for 10: explicit PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX build documentation for B300, an official framework/CUDA support matrix covering B300, explicit NeMo-on-B300 compatibility, and hands-on corroboration of frameworks running on B300.
